title: Tesla China Car System Officially Integrates with Doubao Large Model

content_html:
July 31st news, Tesla China has started to roll out the 2026.14.13 version of the vehicle's infotainment software in batches today. This update covers multiple popular models, including Model 3, Model Y, Model S, and Model X. The most anticipated core upgrade is the official introduction of the Douba large model.

According to the official introduction, after integrating the Douba large model, the Tesla infotainment system can not only provide more real-time and accurate information queries, but also have natural and smooth voice conversations with car owners, greatly enhancing the in-car intelligent interaction experience. However, it should be noted that this AI large model function requires users to activate the premium in-car entertainment service to use normally.

content_html_zh:
7月31日消息，特斯拉中国今日开始批量上线2026.14.13版车辆信息娱乐软件。 本次更新涵盖多款热门车型，包括 Model 3、Model Y、Model S 和 Model X。 最值得期待的核心升级莫过于豆霸大模型的正式推出。

据官方介绍，集成豆霸大车型后，特斯拉信息娱乐系统不仅可以提供更加实时准确的信息查询，还可以与车主进行自然流畅的语音对话，大大提升了车内智能交互体验。 不过需要注意的是，这项AI大车型功能需要用户激活高级车载娱乐服务才能正常使用。
